title: Unimodal products of q-analogs: one clause of the conjecture is false
summary: The clause "necessary when p ≤ 3" fails for (1+q)⁶(1+q³).
source: B. B. Connelly, E. Ito, T. C. Martinez, O. Shevchenko, K. Yang, "Unimodality of q-Fibonomial coefficients for small cases", arXiv:2605.12822v1 (12 May 2026), the conjecture of the last section.
label: lean
first_by: The same counterexample with a Lean proof, in `the-omega-institute/trureturing`, merged 10 September 2026.
